data_manifest.calendar: SSE observed trading sessions; future calendar is not market data
data_manifest.membership: Historical intervals from provider index snapshots; not a PIT guarantee

interpretation.costs: Native portfolio replays vary explicit fees, fixed slippage assumptions and capital; multipliers are not a market impact or capacity model.
interpretation.holdout: Exploratory 2024 implementation screening; the snapshot and historical periods have been inspected. No fresh confirmation evidence.
interpretation.portfolio: Each fold starts an independent funded portfolio; fold returns must not be concatenated as a continuously traded strategy. Qlib lifecycle settlement remains qualified until independently reconciled.
interpretation.seeds: Initialization dispersion is not uncertainty across market regimes; paired intervals resample dates.

selection.aggregation: mean validation metric across all declared seeds; no seed selection
selection.fallback: validation RMSE only when no candidate has a finite registered primary metric
selection.incomplete_policy: no fold selection until every registered trial completes
